findings.title: Live E2E (AC7-AC14) not executable: no authenticated session (recorded limitation, not a code defect)

evidence.excerpt: Backend reachable: curl -k https://localhost:9002/actuator/health -> 200 {"status":"UP",mongo UP}; but GET https://localhost:9002/api/v1/automations/shipment-invoice -> 401 and POST /api/v1/auth/login -> 401. No OTP/SMS login, test user, token or JWKS fixture is available, so the authenticated journey cannot be driven over the real transport. Recorded as blocker B1; P11 exit gate permits deviations recorded as blockers. No fixer action possible until a session is provisioned.

findings.suggested_fix: Provision a local test user/token and run the P11 acceptance checklist against the backend, recording per-AC results. Environmental only: no code change is implied and no fixer loop is expected for this item.

suggestions.title: getAudit service return type does not match the documented {requestId, events} envelope
suggestions.note: getAudit is typed Promise<AuditEvent[]> but the task (3.7) documents {requestId, events:[...]}; the context normalizes at runtime via 'as unknown' (ShipmentInvoiceContext.tsx:319-325). Type the service return as the envelope and normalize inside the service, mirroring normaliseOutputDocument.

suggestions.title: retryGenerate surfaces a 409 code but does not refresh the review
suggestions.note: Unlike approve/reparse and the six row mutations, retryGenerate's catch stores readErrorCode(err) but never refetches. It runs from the failed step where no review grid is mounted, so impact is low; consider a refresh for consistency with the AC14 rule.

suggestions.title: Superseded dist bundles remain tracked after a rebuild
suggestions.note: Each building commit adds its new bundle but leaves the prior one tracked (e.g. app.dbca767 stays tracked after 2c606d0 repointed index.html to app.830cd859). Matches the P4-P10 pattern and is pre-existing churn; a future cleanup could stage the deletions.
